product_metadata.title: SOFTCOTT 100% Cotton Bath Towel Set Aqua Pack of 6 Cotton Terry Towels for Bathroom 24x48 Soft Ring Spun Spa Hotel Gym Shower Bathroom Towels
features: Cotton rich towels Set of 6 pcs in aqua blue Color measuring 24 x 48 Inch, with double stitched hems, thick and plush terry makes our bath towel ultra-soft.
Highly absorbent towels with quick dry ability, naturally soft, breathable, and comfortable material of towel sets provide a pleasing experience after bathing.
These are multi-purpose towels ideal for makeup wipes, salon, beach, spa, gym, your hands and face, and as college dorm room essentials.
Premium cotton blend bath towel set, made from high-quality ringspun cotton with Light Weight & Absorbent material.
Wash your towels before the first use to remove any excess lint leftover from the manufacturing process and allows the cotton fibres to open up and give the towels better absorbency.
